thesis: This episode argues that Google has created the single greatest business ever, generating more profit than any other US company, including Berkshire Hathaway. However, the thesis notes that this dominant business trades at a significant discount to peers like Microsoft, Apple, and Nvidia, a valuation gap the speakers attribute to investor concerns regarding AI.

claims.claim: Google has a profitable business model but its stock trades at significantly lower multiples than peers due to AI concerns.
claims.quote: Today, things are not so obvious once again for Google. Despite earning more profits than all of its big tech peers, its stock trades at significantly lower multiples — a $1 trillion or more discount to Apple, Microsoft and Nvidia.
